text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I came to an open-air cafe with Ryoka Tsurugi,
but—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahhhh!?!?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Tsurugi-san!!!! And Trainer, too!! What a coincidence!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Yes! Actually, you see—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After being invited to tag along, Sonon Elfie led the way to a spot
where Umamusume around her age were waving over at them.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Hat
text_block_list.text: Hey there! Whoa, getting to chat with an academy Trainer is such a rare treat~.

text_block_list.name: Blue-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while, Ms. Tsurugi.
Sorry for dragging you into this on your day off.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
No, no, please don't worry about it.
I want to support everyone's activities too, after all.
choice_data_list: Excuse me, what kind of activities do they do...?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Um. To put it simply, it's 'support activities for retired Umamusume'!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Through streaming, I want to show other Umamusume
that there's a path to enjoying sports outside of racing, but――

text_block_list.name: Blue-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Along similar lines, we've been active in various ways too.
Like holding seminars for girls considering retirement to show them
all the other paths open to them.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Hat
text_block_list.text: Yes. Actually, just like Elfie, I'm a former Tracen Academy student myself~.

text_block_list.name: Blue-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: We may not have left our mark through race results... but each of us found our own different path.
choice_data_list: ...If it's alright, could you tell me more about that?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely!! I really wanted you to know,
Trainer! All about who we are!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
To reiterate! There are also girls who take up
brand-new sports, just like me!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Sports with custom rules have been increasing year by year
so that Umamusume can compete at full power and have fun!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
They love training, and they love moving their bodies!
I want to show a path to the future for girls like that!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Hat
text_block_list.text:
This is my workplace.
...Ehehe, believe it or not, it's the racetrack~.
Or more specifically, the URA.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Hat
text_block_list.text:
Quite a few former race Umamusume actually find
new paths in life by joining Umamusume organizations
like the URA or the NAU~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Hat
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I work as an outrider Umamusume.
Guiding the girls who are overwhelmed with nerves and excitement, leading them out safely――

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Hat
text_block_list.text:
...I just love racing so much.
I want to show them that there are other ways to be involved too~.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Coach~!
How was that just now~?!

text_block_list.name: Blue-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, perfect! Your cornering has gotten
so much better. ...Right, one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Blue-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—I used to attend this development club
back when I was little, too. Even then,
a former racehorse Umamusume coach taught us with great passion.

text_block_list.name: Blue-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Admiration for her led me down the same Tiara path...
Hehe, though my results weren't all that impressive.

text_block_list.name: Blue-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Even so, thinking there might be something I could do,
I chose the same path she did.
...It's an option I want to demonstrate with pride.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: —How was that, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Blue-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad! If it sparked your interest,
that makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Blue-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Especially…… for someone like you, who stays by
the side of the active Umamusume girls.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Hat
text_block_list.text: Even at Tracen Academy, you can earn up to high school credits, and if you ever drop out mid-year, they'll refer you to transfer schools, so――

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Hat
text_block_list.text:
Of course, going on to college normally and getting a regular job
is totally fine too, though.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
The more options you have, the more fun it is!
I want to show them that there are so many places where they belong, so many futures!

text_block_list.name: Blue-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Especially for the girls who've come to believe
that their dreams won't ever come true.

text_block_list.name: Blue-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's okay to find a new dream, and it's okay
to work hard all over again to make it come true……
That's what we want to convey to them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, on the way back after parting ways
with Sonon Elfie and the others...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san? You seem to have been lost in thought for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I intend to support her with everything I have so that no regrets linger, but... even so, the day will eventually come when she must step away from her current stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, which path will she choose next?
...What new dream will she embrace?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
May blessings shine upon that distant future as wellâ
With that prayer in my heart, I made my way home under the evening sky.
